workLog.action: Fixed two current-head suppressed Copilot findings.
workLog.result: The QA scope now matches GitHub's 15-file count. Node.js is pinned to reviewed release 24.19.0, and the workflow version test asserts Python, uv, and Node.js exact versions.

workLog.action: Fixed the final-head checkout guard finding.
workLog.result: git read-tree -n and --dry-run no longer populate index state. --index-output records the actual destination index. All 189 workflow checkout tests pass.
Cancelled predecessor runs skip check-run creation and final publication, so a replacement run cannot have its pending or success verdict overwritten. All 229 provenance tests pass.
Bootstrap and validator-owned head-state writes compare GITHUB_RUN_ID against status history and reject an older generation. All 232 provenance tests pass.

workLog.action: Excluded commits already reachable from origin tips in the placeholder identity guard.
workLog.result: Merging a placeholder-authored commit already on origin/main no longer blocks a clean feature push, while a new placeholder commit remains blocked. Five focused tests pass.

Pull-request runs fetch immutable SHAs before materialization. The workflow parser handles |& and rejects materialization nested in multiline control flow or heredoc text. All 232 provenance and 198 workflow checkout tests pass.

workLog.action: Closed the pre-fetch stale-success and local-ref trust gaps.
workLog.result: A run-token pending status publishes before any Git operation. Placeholder exclusions come from authenticated git ls-remote output, and a fake local refs/remotes entry cannot hide a new placeholder commit. Six focused identity tests pass.

workLog.action: Closed merge-group status and missing-object exclusions.
workLog.result: Bootstrap pending status is pull-request-only. Identity exclusions require both authenticated remote membership and local object resolution, so unfetched branch tips cannot break git log.

workLog.action: Removed unsafe merge_group execution from the privileged workflow.
workLog.result: ADR-096 now requires a separate base-owned merge queue design. Six amendment roles voted ACCEPT after stale merge-group tests were removed and exact 181/125 line-count assertions were added. The provenance suite passes 231 tests.
A bootstrap API failure warns and continues to the base validator, where retried Commit Status and Check Run startup preserve the dual-channel recovery path.

workLog.action: Closed config symlink and shell parser gaps.
workLog.result: Markdownlint policy rejects symlinks before reads. The checkout guard rejects brace groups, subshells, function bodies, heredocs, and multiline control flow, and preserves backslash-newline token semantics. All 232 provenance and 198 workflow checkout tests pass.

workLog.action: Disabled checkout content filters during immutable materialization.
workLog.result: All base and candidate checkout-index calls use --no-filter, so candidate .gitattributes cannot invoke smudge filters or transform bytes before hashing.

workLog.action: Replaced mutable login authorization with numeric GitHub user IDs.
workLog.result: Both pull request author and event sender IDs must equal 6811113 on opened or synchronize events. Six ADR roles reached ACCEPT or Disagree-and-Commit, and 232 provenance tests pass.

workLog.action: Expanded authenticated identity exclusions across origin heads.
workLog.result: git ls-remote enumerates all origin branches, but only locally present objects are excluded. Cross-feature history passes without allowing fake or unfetched refs. Seven focused tests pass.
